programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management - Communications (PGDM-C)
programs.feeNote: Total programme fee INR 29.50 lakh for the 2027-29 batch as listed on MICA's Admissions '27 page (indicative, subject to revision). MICA's PGDM-C programme page states the fee includes tuition, hostel, mess, teaching-learning materials and infrastructure. Application fee Rs 2,500 + Rs 500 per additional programme.
programs.intakeNote: 180 seats for PGDM-C (2027-29) per MICA admissions pages. MICA also offers PGDM (60 seats).
programs.placementNote: Official MICA Placement Brochure 2026-27, 'Final Placements - Batch 2024-26' (labelled PGP; 197 students placed, 91 recruiters, 100% placement): highest CTC 45.67 LPA, average 20.12 LPA, median 19.57 LPA, top-25 average 34.00 LPA. The report does not split PGDM-C and PGDM. Not stated as audited. (MICA's PGDM-C web page separately shows 'Average 19.22 LPA, highest 40.91 LPA' labelled 2025 data; not used.)

programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: Total fee INR 29.50 lakh (indicative, subject to revision) for the 2027-29 batch per MICA PGDM admissions page and Admissions '27 table.
programs.intakeNote: 60 seats per MICA PGDM admissions page (2027-29).
programs.placementNote: No programme-specific PGDM placement figures published; see PGDM-C entry for the combined PGP 2024-26 report.

selectionProcess.name: CAT/XAT/GMAT score (mandatory) and MICAT
selectionProcess.detail: MICAT (psychometric, descriptive, aptitude sections) is mandatory; psychometric section is a qualifier, then a minimum CAT/XAT/GMAT cut-off, then sectional cut-offs on MICAT Sections C and B. Best of MICAT I/II counts.

selectionProcess.name: Group Exercise (GE) and Personal Interview (PI)
selectionProcess.detail: GE & PI in March at Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Delhi, Kolkata or Mumbai; candidate must be recommended by a majority of panellists.

selectionProcess.name: Final composite merit list
selectionProcess.weightage: CAT/XAT/GMAT 35%, MICAT 25%, GE 10%, PI 20%, Class 10/12/graduation 5%, extra-curricular/diversity 5%
selectionProcess.detail: Weights as published for Batch 2026-2028; MICA had not posted a 2027-29 version of this document as of 2026-11-12.

selectionWeightage.note: Published for Batch 2026-2028 (PGDM-C and PGDM); 2027-29 weights not separately published as of 2026-11-12.

keyDates.notes: MICAT I: registration closes 21 Nov 2026, exam 5 Dec 2026, score 18 Dec 2026. MICAT II: registration 25 Nov 2026 - 30 Jan 2027, exam 12 Feb 2027, score 28 Feb 2027. CAT/XAT/GMAT score submission deadline 30 Jan 2027. GE-PI and merit-list dates for 2027 not yet published.
